slots.name: criminal charges status
slots.sentence: In mid-September, Doe filed a lawsuit against the seven men who she alleges assaulted her two years ago. Cornell was also named in the lawsuit.

slots.sentence: CBS News New York, citing a transcript of a conversation between Jane Doe and investigators, reported Wednesday that she told campus police: “I can say with 100% confidence I was raped.
